description: Agent kind catalog, v1. `kinds` lists the canonical kind ids in the app's SupportedAgentKind declaration order (Swift raw values; Antigravity is `agy`). The Swift tests assert SupportedAgentKind.allCases raw values equal `kinds`, in order; the plugin tests assert sidebar-config's AGENT_IDS (herdr's canonical labels) hold exactly these ids, and that every Status Hook kind (agent-hooks HOOK_AGENTS) is one of them.
